name: grammar-ai
description: Fix grammar, spelling and punctuation inline as you type, using a free local AI model. Works in Cursor and VS Code.
author: Doron Kaspi

commands.title: Grammar AI: Fix Grammar in Selection
Grammar AI: Fix Grammar in Whole Document

enumDescriptions: Free and private: a local Ollama model first, then the Claude Code CLI as backup.
A local model in Ollama only. Free and fully private.
The Claude Code CLI (claude -p). Uses your Claude sign-in.
grammarAI.provider.description: Which AI engine corrects your text. All options are free to run.

grammarAI.ollama.model.description: The Ollama model to use. A small instruct model is fast and accurate enough for grammar.

grammarAI.claudeCode.path.description: Path to the claude executable. Leave empty to find it automatically.

grammarAI.mode.description: How aggressively to correct. Basic fixes only clear errors; Natural also smooths awkward phrasing; Professional makes it clearer and more formal.

grammarAI.asYouType.enabled.description: Underline grammar issues as you type and offer a quick fix. Off by default; it sends the paragraph you are editing to the AI after you pause.

grammarAI.asYouType.delayMs.description: How long to wait after you stop typing before checking the paragraph, in milliseconds.

grammarAI.languageIds.description: Which document types as-you-type suggestions apply to. Add "*" for all.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Typfix
walkthroughs.description: Fix grammar inline with a free local AI model.

steps.title: Install a free local model (optional)
steps.description: Typfix works best with a free model on your Mac. Install [Ollama](https://ollama.com), then run `ollama pull qwen3:1.7b` in a terminal. No Ollama? Typfix falls back to Claude Code.

steps.title: Fix your first sentence
steps.description:
Select some text and press **Cmd+Shift+G** (Ctrl+Shift+G on Windows/Linux), or run **Typfix: Fix Grammar in Selection** from the Command Palette.
[Run it now](command:grammarAI.fixSelection)

steps.title: Turn on as-you-type suggestions (optional)
steps.description:
Get grammar issues underlined as you type, with a one-click Quick Fix.
[Toggle as-you-type](command:grammarAI.toggleAsYouType)

scripts.package: npm run build -- --minify && vsce package --no-dependencies -o grammar-ai.vsix
